#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate surface energy for Aluminum
"""

# Given values
E_slab = -1631.81096843743  # eV
E_bulk = -1679.8628  # eV
N_slab = 500  # atoms
N_bulk = 500  # atoms

# Box dimensions after 5x5x5 replication
box_x = 20.19465  # Angstrom
box_y = 20.19465  # Angstrom

# Calculate surface area (one surface)
A = box_x * box_y  # Angstrom^2

print(f"Slab energy: {E_slab} eV")
print(f"Bulk energy: {E_bulk} eV")
print(f"Number of atoms in slab: {N_slab}")
print(f"Number of atoms in bulk: {N_bulk}")
print(f"Surface area (one surface): {A} Å²")

# Surface energy formula: γ = (E_slab - (N_slab/N_bulk) * E_bulk) / (2 * A)
# Since N_slab = N_bulk, this simplifies to: γ = (E_slab - E_bulk) / (2 * A)

gamma = (E_slab - E_bulk) / (2 * A)

print(f"\nSurface energy calculation:")
print(f"γ = (E_slab - E_bulk) / (2 * A)")
print(f"γ = ({E_slab} - {E_bulk}) / (2 * {A})")
print(f"γ = {E_slab - E_bulk} / {2 * A}")
print(f"γ = {gamma} eV/Å²")
print(f"\nFinal surface energy: {gamma:.2f} eV/Å²")
